Theo: FYI  new Senior ML Infra starts Mon 9am PT. Need a compact week0 plan + a one-page candidate summary and a manager-facing 30/60/90 checklist. Anita can you own?
Anita: Yep. Quick confirms: buddy? laptop imaging Friday? NDA?
Mira: I can buddy mornings 9:30-10:00 for first 2 weeks. IT says imaging ok if asset tag by EOD.
IT-bot: Ticket created: #7823 (laptop image, Okta, GH org invite). Owner: IT.
Anita: Proposed week0 (ultra-lean):
```
Mon AM: Welcome + accounts + Slack intro
Mon PM: Team demo + dev env pairing
Tue: Code tour + first micro-PR
Wed: Runbooks + observability + NDA check
Thu: Deploy workflow + smoke canary
Fri: 30m manager review + buddy retro
```
Anita: Candidate one-pager (short): 30d env ready + 1-2 small PRs; 60d owns a non-peak deploy; 90d independent deploys + proposed perf idea. Key contacts: buddy Mira, manager Theo, infra owner. NDA link included if required.
Anita: Manager 30/60/90 (brief):
- Week0: confirm accounts, daily 15m check-ins, 3 micro-tasks assigned
- 30d: 2 PRs merged, can run tests, buddy feedback
- 60d: owns deploy for one service (canary), incident-debug demo
- 90d: leads tech review, independent deploys, recommended perf/cost improvement
Theo: Add Manager quick tips: explicit acceptance criteria for micro-tasks, daily 15m, schedule end-of-week 30m review, mid-30d feedback checkpoint. Also ensure NDA gating for dataset access.
legal-bot: NDA flag noted; link will be added to candidate email.
people-ops-bot: Onboarding packet created: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/1849991234
Mira: I'll send calendar invites for pairing and attach a "how to run tests" doc.
Anita: I'll draft both the candidate one-pager and manager doc and post here for sign-off by EOD.
Theo: Thanks  once posted I will review and hiring manager will send to candidate. :thumbsup:
